pages.title: AZX SERVICE TIME
pages.text:
■ This is a mini game where you can experience the meal service of the AZX.
■ Drag blocks until the sum of their numbers reaches 10. This will clear them and earn you points.
■ The game ends when the timer hits 0, or when no more blocks can be cleared.
■ Clear as many blocks as possible before the game ends to earn a high score.

pages.title: Cargo Spaces
pages.text:
■ Cargo spaces contain blocks that award points.
■ Each space only contains a certain number of blocks.
■ The larger the capacity of the cargo space, the smaller the blocks.

pages.title: Attendants and Blocks
pages.text:
■ Before starting the game, you can choose which attendant to play as.
■ The appearance of the blocks will change according to the attendant chosen.

pages.title: Skills
pages.text:
Cat's Eye
■ Nero finds a combo in the cargo space that can be cleared and highlights it.

Feline Flurry
■ Nero makes a mess of the blocks, pausing the timer as she does so.
■ Once she's done, blocks in the cargo space are reassigned numbers at random.

Thanks Fur All the Fish
■ All blocks become fish-shaped.
■ When you select a fish-shaped block, it will be cleared immediately and all remaining blocks will return to their original shape.

pages.title: Exiting the Game
pages.text:
■ Tap the Exit Game button in the upper right corner or press ESC to open the exit game window.
■ The game timer will continue to run while the window is open.
